# Design point P020

## Description

The system maintains a normal Git repository on fast local NVMe storage to support reference-transaction synchronization, while Git performance capabilities formerly provided by Scalar are delivered through the core Git client. These choices are complementary: local repository state supports coordination, and the integrated client path improves protocol or hosting performance.
